info.name: Vayo Finance Partner API
info.description:
Partner-facing routes: Mode S build/submit, lending market reads, dashboard analytics, payments (on/off-ramp + transactions), health probes, and the inbound rebalance-confirmation webhook. Mode V was removed in 2026 — partners now sign locally for every operation. Set the collection variables (baseUrl, apiKey) before running. Mutating requests include a fresh Idempotency-Key by default; reuse the same key when retrying.

Regenerate via openapi-to-postmanv2 from packages/core-sdk/openapi.json after re-exporting the spec.
